digest.component_or_area: env-vars registry and config ownership gate
propositions: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS contains 4 ghost rows (_rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) with no corresponding function definitions under src/rebar, creating a table->tree validation gap symmetric with the existing tree->table validation
Ghost rows exempt unowned env reads from the config-ownership gate because matching by name alone allows calls to non-existent helpers to bypass _shim_access checks

The stale row for _str_pref went live->ghost simultaneously with deletion of its call sites (REBAR_GATE_REF/REBAR_GATE_SOURCE), serving as an undetected signal of key loss that remained undiagnosed for three days

A root-independent validation seam must validate KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS against DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT (shipped src/rebar surface), not against scan()'s arbitrary root argument, to avoid false positives on synthetic test trees where 13 of 13 rows appear stale
